subject: app-rdef
title: (R)APP.RDEF.------T.C.IMP.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-11, the second of two on book p107. (R)APP-RDEF — the reality of *applied redefinitions* — is crossed with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). The schematic stages Braxton's argument that the source-transfer cycle of black culture into composite western culture forced *applied* redefinitions on every aspect of vibrational and methodological thrust projection — and these redefinitions, while necessary for survival, carry their own time-continuum implications that recur across cycles. APP-RDEF → T-C-IMP branches into ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance) → RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). A separate chain runs APP-RDEF → POL-DYM (political dynamics) → INFO-OR (information order) → (r)RE-DIF (the reality of redefinitions) → RT-DY (reality dynamics) → (p)RE-ST (the point of activation of restructuralism). The structural claim: applied redefinitions, once enacted, are not finished — they propagate through political dynamics into information order, generate further redefinitions, and only contingently activate as restructuralism (the (p) prefix marking conditional point-of-activation). The diagram makes Braxton's slavery-and-survival argument structural: redefinition under duress recurs across the time continuum.
